description:
Fetch a gene's sequence prepared for expression prediction.

        Resolves the gene's TSS via Ensembl and returns a 9,198 bp
        gene-sense window with the TSS at offset 4,599 (its midpoint), as a
        handle to pass to predict_expression(sequence_ref=...). That is the
        minimum valid input for every expression model, and at 9,198 bp it
        needs no `tss_index`.

        It is all the default g0-expression reads, but a model may recommend
        a wider flank: bio_spec.recommended_flank_bp from list_models (e.g.
        40,960 bp for g0-expression-8192). To supply flank F, call
        fetch_region(region=<this handle's region>, strand=<its strand>,
        flank_bp=F - 4,599), which returns 2F bp with the TSS at offset F,
        and pass tss_index=F to predict_expression. If the returned sequence
        is not exactly 2F bp (the gene is near a chromosome end), the TSS is
        not at F: use a smaller flank.
name: fetch_gene_for_expression
